newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia liquidates Batiment firm in sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia liquidates Batiment firm in sell-off.

text.p: Tunisia has issued a tender to sell off the real estate of state-owned Batiment, a leading building sector firm, as part of its privatisation programme.
The tender call, published in Tunisian Arabic newspapers on Monday, said the properties would be sold in 17 lots divided according to their geographical location.
Lawyers said the sales would effectively mean the liquidation of the company, which will cease its materials and equipment trading activities in a sector crowded with private firms.
